meta.name: citation-management
meta.description: Comprehensive citation management for academic research. Search OpenAlex, PubMed, and Google Scholar for papers, extract accurate metadata, validate citations, and generate properly formatted BibTeX entries. This skill should be used when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检索学术文献并生成规范参考文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果平时需要大量检索和引用学术文献
copy.tagline_en: Find papers and generate correctly formatted citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently search and cite academic literature

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按你的要求搜索 Google Scholar 与 PubMed 上的学术文献，从 DOI、PMID、arXiv ID 等提取元数据，生成规范 BibTeX；还会自动补全缺失字段、验证引用、清理和去重 BibTeX 文件。
howto.when: 当你要查找论文、验证引用信息、或将 DOI 转为 BibTeX 时触发；也用于确保参考文献准确。

say.text: 帮我搜一下关于CRISPR基因编辑的最新论文
say.note: 会调用 Google Scholar 搜索并返回结果列表

say.text: 检查我的 references.bib 里有没有缺卷号或页码的条目
say.note: 会扫描不完整条目并通过网络补全

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search academic literature on Google Scholar and PubMed, extract metadata from DOIs, PMIDs, arXiv IDs, generate properly formatted BibTeX entries, automatically fill missing fields, validate citations, and clean/deduplicate BibTeX files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to find papers, verify citation information, convert DOIs to BibTeX, or ensure reference accuracy in scientific writing; also used for validating and cleaning BibTeX files.

say_en.text: Search for recent papers on CRISPR gene editing.
say_en.note: Calls Google Scholar and returns a result list.
Extracts metadata and generates the entry.

say_en.text: Check references.bib for missing volume or page fields.
say_en.note: Scans incomplete entries and fills them via web search.
